theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (Bad : Set (Rn N × (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N) × Rn N)), MeasurableSet Bad → ∀ a : Rn N, (∀ H : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → μHE[n] {x | x ∈ H ∧ ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ (a, H.starProjection, x) ∈ Bad} = 0) → ∀ θ : Measure (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), IsProbabilityMeasure θ → (∀ᵐ g ∂θ, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1) → (∀ k : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint k * k = 1 → Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ) → ∀ V : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ V = n + 1 → 0 < μHE[n] {x : Rn N | x ∈ V ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} → μHE[n] {x : Rn N | x ∈ V ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} < ∞ → ∀ ζ ∈ V, ‖ζ‖ = 1 → θ {g | (a, g * V.starProjection * ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g, g ζ) ∈ Bad} = 0
